author: Karl Rock
description:
I went looking for Hyderabad’s famous Haji Rabri Wale to try rabri, one of Pakistan’s most popular traditional desserts. But there was one problem: I accidentally ended up at a similarly named rabri shop just a few doors away!

So I decided to try both.

In this Pakistani food adventure, I taste rabri at both shops in Hyderabad, Sindh, compare the original with its similarly named neighbour, and find out which one I actually prefer.

Rabri is a traditional South Asian milk dessert made by slowly reducing milk until it becomes thick, rich and creamy. You’ll find different versions of rabri across Pakistan and India, and Hyderabad is particularly famous for it.
